source: Higgsfield Hell Grind CINEDANCE skill + MiniMax H3 官方指南
style_prefix: Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic. Cinematography: floating immersive camera that lives with the actors; natural motivated light; painterly composed frames, strong silhouettes against the light. Lighting: Natural light only — contre-jour backlight, camera on shadow side, atmospheric haze throughout. Key light from sky and windows only. Color: 60:30:10 — dominant / secondary / accent. Camera: Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur. Skin: Pore-level realism — vellus hair, asymmetric moles, capillary flush, pore-shadow matching on-set light. Acting: Hollywood — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise. Physics: Gravity and inertia respected — mass has real weight, correct contact shadows. No floating props. Composition: Rule of thirds + golden ratio. Every person moving from frame one.

sections.name: SCENE CONTEXT
sections.rule: 以『EXACT N CHARACTERS — NO DUPLICATES』开头：发生什么、谁在画面、单次时长。禁止模型添加多余人物/道具。

sections.name: ACTIVE REFERENCES
sections.rule: @标签 命名每个引用（角色/地点）；角色引用保留面容，地点引用『只取空间与材质，不继承构图/角度/色彩』。

sections.name: LOCATION MAP
sections.rule: 用文字画出场地地理：门在画面左、距离、道具位置、相机所在侧，相机永不越线。

sections.name: FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
sections.rule: 首帧站位逐人写清：谁站在哪、朝向、与镜头的距离；首帧无空镜头、无运镜。

sections.name: FORMAT MODE
sections.rule: 单 take 或多硬切、时长（秒）、实时性；MiniMaxH3 用『单段连续 take，15 秒，实时』。

sections.name: OPTICS
sections.rule: 焦距/机位高度/物距/景深：如『≈40° 广角，机位胸口高度，距垫子六米，景深覆盖门与道具』。

sections.name: CAMERA
sections.rule: 运镜行为 + 禁止项：呼吸式手持、慢重构图；禁止推拉/急摇。

sections.name: ACTION TIMING
sections.rule: 动作逐秒分解（0.0-1.0s…8.0-12.0s），每拍不超过三句，避免信息过载糊帧。

sections.name: PHYSICS
sections.rule: 重量/接触/惯性：道具真实重量、摆动滞后一拍、液体随动作倾斜，呼吸是可见的工作。

sections.name: LIGHTING
sections.rule: 单一光源逻辑 + 光源位置；禁用词→安全词：『dark』→『low key』。

sections.name: AUDIO
sections.rule: 仅环境音（diegetic）+ 台词逐字（角色声音描述 verbatim）；无音乐。

sections.name: CHARACTER ACTING
sections.rule: 每个角色：状态 / 想要 / 隐藏什么 / 身体节奏 / 变化点。写行为而非情绪。

sections.name: STYLE
sections.rule: Style Prefix 逐字粘贴到每条提示词结尾。

sections.name: QUALITY
sections.rule: 8K 细节、毛孔级皮肤、无抖动闪烁、多张脸始终等于引用。

sections.name: POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS
sections.rule: 一切数量与禁令写成『画面中确实存在什么』：恰好 N 人、恰好一条水晶臂、五具假人、相机位置、时长。过去时写成现在时。禁用年龄、禁用『不要做X』（模型会反着做）。

wording_rules: 动作只用肯定式：写『falls on his stomach』，不写『does NOT fall on his back』
角色从首帧就在画面里，未要求不得看镜头
永远不写年龄（触发内容过滤）；用角色/服装/动作代替
维护禁用词典：dark→low key，jolting→rapid motion
每拍 ≤3 句；提示词可以长（3000-4000 词），但一拍不能过载
相机写进动作里；现在时、短句
video_negative_prompt: temporal flicker, lighting flicker, frame inconsistency, identity drift, camera jitter, motion jitter, sudden pose change, blurry, distorted, watermark, text
temporal_prompt_rules: 动作用连续式：slow continuous walk / camera smoothly pushes forward
禁止突变：no sudden movement, no sudden pose change
一致性：consistent lighting, stable composition, steady exposure
运镜平滑：smooth camera motion, no jitter
时间锚点：首尾帧 + 中间锚点（25%/50%/75%）比只有首尾帧稳定
